sources.snippet: The server and client are also designed to be used with different models. The default model is Oriserve/Whisper-Hindi2Hinglish-Swift but you can also use Oriserve/Whisper-Hindi2Hinglish-Prime for a better performance. Allowing for real-time transcription of audios. The server and client use websockets to communicate with each other.
